mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (inflation) in the most recent month compared to the prior month is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real corporate profits and prompts central bank tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has risen in the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS increased by >0.1% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining UNRATE (labor market tightening) combined with a rising INDPRO (industrial output growth) signals strong economic momentum that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is declining and INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST rising above 1500 thousand units), consumer spending and business investment increase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO rising above 102.0) signals robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS rising above 158000 thousand) indicates robust job growth, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 158000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE falling below 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to inflationary pressures and central bank tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising HOUST (housing starts) combined with a rising RSAFS (retail sales) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS are both rising, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
